comment: The outputs are created without configOutput, so they have no names in the module browser or in a tooltip; the panel numbers them 1 to 16. Only the sixteenth output can be polyphonic, and only while Polyphonic mode is checked (src/faderbank/FaderbankModule.cpp:32-43). The maker's manual calls the size menu item 'Fader length'; the source prints 'Fader size' (src/faderbank/FaderbankWidget.cpp:176), and the lines follow the source. The range field is left off the output props because the voltage range is a menu setting rather than a fixed fact.
